unique_value: HIGH and CRITICAL sensor dissent freezes recommendations instead of averaging disagreement away
cross-sensor dissent is retained as deterministic alternate-label clusters with an explicit severity tier
bounded recovery from a prior freeze can only release into review after a stable non-freezing window
unknown tracks remain UNKNOWN/review-bound rather than being coerced into friendly certainty

extractable_mechanisms: stable concurrent majority and freeze selection
capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning Anduril-specialist implementation; extraction does not transfer repository identity or erase lineage.

next_evolution: Verify sensor identity/signatures cryptographically, persist dissent-cluster lineage, and chain recovery decisions to durable receipts without weakening fail-closed freeze semantics.
nonclaims: SensorOpinion.signature is fingerprint-bound evidence only; signature authenticity is not yet verified by this mechanism
